title: 南苏丹石油繁荣：清洁水变毒水，官员试图压制真相
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Every day we fight. We don't have to fight.
segments.zh: 我们每天都在争斗。我们本不必争斗。

segments.en: We need to fight for our own good.
segments.zh: 我们需要为自身利益而战。

segments.en: There's no way we can fight.
We don't have to fight for our own good.
segments.zh: 我们不必为自身利益而战。

segments.en: South Sudan has been marked by years of conflict, much of which has been waged over the oil fields in the north of the country.
segments.zh: 南苏丹多年冲突不断，其中许多冲突围绕该国北部的油田展开。

segments.en: A week of fighting in South Sudan shows no signs of a beating.
segments.zh: 南苏丹一周的战事未见平息迹象。

segments.en: Forces loyal to the form of Vice-President have seized the main city of a key world-producing region.
segments.zh: 效忠前副总统的部队已占领一个主要产油区的核心城市。

segments.en: Amidst the fighting, there have been reports of intermittent health scares linked to deformities and congenital disease.
segments.zh: 战乱中，有报道称出现与畸形和先天性疾病相关的间歇性健康恐慌。

segments.en: I've received a series of documents, minutes, letters and medical reports that highlight the high levels of congenital disease in the area.
segments.zh: 我收到一系列文件、会议记录、信件和医疗报告，凸显该地区先天性疾病高发。

segments.en: It also unearthed an attempt by officials to suppress the information.
segments.zh: 还发现官员试图压制相关信息。

segments.en: We helped you to move this, you used to use the plane when you were getting in the car.
segments.zh: 我们帮你搬这个，你以前上车时都用飞机。
